title: ExplorerCatalogItems
responsibility: Renders module collections and relationships through one shared card, retaining tables only for config variable values.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems.category
inputs.description: The collection the rows are listed in, or null for a dependency that no collection lists. It is passed to each module card and selects the ex-page-grid class for pages, and the configs table is used only when it is configs and every row is a setting.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems.rows
inputs.description: The rows to render, in the order given: the component neither sorts nor filters them, and with batch above 0 it shows only the leading rows. Each row.id keys its card or table row, so two rows with the same id throw.

entity.name: ExplorerCatalogItems
entity.purpose: Renders module collections and relationships through one shared card, retaining tables only for config variable values.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems.nav
inputs.description: Navigation for every link: route is the current location, from which each link keeps the branch and, unless it names one, the commit. href gives a link's address, go runs when a plain click follows the link, and source, when given, opens a consumer's owned file from its source button.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems.lens
inputs.description: The evidence lens: evidence(unit) supplies the captures that each visual card (pages, components or layouts) takes its screenshot from, and an open preview of a visual consumer takes its image from it. It is never called for a dependency or a non-visual row.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems.mediaBase
inputs.description: The URL prefix joined in front of a capture's file name, as mediaBase + file, for each card image and consumer preview. It is concatenated exactly as given, with no separator added.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems.verification
inputs.description: It is passed only to ExplorerTable, which reads it only for non-configs categories to show a Verification column. This component renders that table only for configs, so the value changes no output here.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems.batch
inputs.description: Rows shown at first and added per View More press; 0, the default, and any value not above 0 (including NaN) show every row with no group or View More action, and a fractional value is truncated by slice.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems.label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the batched group, used only when batch is above 0; the View More action is labelled 'View more' followed by the label's first word. Defaults to category ?? 'Other' when not given: the category, or Other when category is null.

outputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems
outputs.description: The rows in their supplied order: module cards inside an hx-div with class ex-page-grid for pages or ex-catalog-grid otherwise, or one configs table when category is configs and every row is a setting. With batch above 0 they sit in a role=group hx-div labelled by label, and View More focuses the first a[href] of the first newly shown article or tbody tr.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: A function card serializes its documented example arguments with JSON.stringify, which throws a TypeError for a BigInt or a circular reference, and the error propagates out of the card's rendering.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: A deeply nested example argument can exceed the call stack while JSON.stringify serializes it for a function card, throwing a RangeError that propagates out of the card's rendering.

errors.name: Example serialization callback error
errors.description: A getter, proxy trap or toJSON method on an example argument can throw during that JSON.stringify, and the error propagates out of the function card's rendering.

errors.name: nav.href callback error
errors.description: An error thrown by nav.href propagates while a module card, a configs table row or a consumer link renders its address.

errors.name: nav.go callback error
errors.description: An error thrown by nav.go propagates out of the click handler when a module card, a configs table row or a consumer link is followed by a plain click.

errors.name: nav.source callback error
errors.description: An error thrown by nav.source propagates out of the click handler when a consumer's source button is activated.

errors.name: lens.evidence callback error
errors.description: An error thrown by lens.evidence propagates while a visual module card resolves its screenshot or a visual consumer's preview opens.

errors.name: each_key_duplicate
errors.description: Two rows with the same id make Svelte's keyed each block throw each_key_duplicate when the module-card list or the configs table is mounted or updated.
